source_title: Kamal Haasan - SU Arun Kumar film to be titled 'Sandiyar'; first look planned for actor's birthday - Repo - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Tamil superstar Kamal Haasan's upcoming collaboration with director SU Arun Kumar is reportedly set to be titled 'Sandiyar'. The project is expected to be a gritty action entertainer, with reports suggesting that its photoshoot has already been completed. The film's first-look poster and stills may be released on the actor's birthday.According to Valai Pechu, the makers are considering 'Sandiyar' as the title. Shooting is reportedly expected to begin in November. However, the production team has not officially confirmed the title, promotional plans or schedule. The upcoming film brings Kamal Haasan together with SU Arun Kumar, who directed 'Veera Dheera Sooran'.The actor officially announced the collaboration in September. Kamal Haasan shared the announcement on social media with the caption âTho Vaarenâ and a fire emoji. He also tagged SU Arun Kumar in the post. Expectations are high for the upcoming movie.Action entertainer reportedly set in MaduraiAccording to reports, the upcoming project will feature a full-fledged action narrative with a gritty and realistic approach. The makers are reportedly planning to shoot the entire film in Madurai, Tamil Nadu. Kamal Haasan is said to have a short-haired appearance in the project. Reports also suggest that the film will avoid CGI-based de-aging and dance sequences.These details have not been confirmed by the filmmakers yet.Test shoot photographA photograph believed to be from the test shoot surfaced online before the official announcement. It showed Kamal Haasan dressed in a simple shirt and trousers, holding what appeared to be a throwing knife.His rugged appearance prompted speculation about the character he might portray. The image also led to discussions about the film's possible action elements.On the other hand, Kamal Haasan was last seen in a leading role in Mani Ratnam's 'Thug Life', which co-stars STR. He also appeared in 'Indian 2' following the success of Lokesh Kanagaraj's 'Vikram'.
